description: PHASE 3 Runtime Verification: Complete runtime verification with HTTP health checks and final gate metadata generation. Wave R6 adds health check verification with fallback strategy to ApplicationProcess in runtime.py. Wave R7 deferred to M3 (Playwright integration requires prerequisites not met). Wave R9 implements final_gate.py agent handler that generates FinalVerdict JSON and appends to canonical backlog. Sequential execution R6 → R7(deferred) → R9 per approved design.
steps: 2. Add get_health_url(target: str) -> str function to runtime.py that constructs health check URL using APP_PORTS mapping: f'http://localhost:{port}/api/health'

3. Add verify_health(health_url: str, timeout: int = 10) -> bool method to ApplicationProcess class that implements fallback strategy: try /api/health → try /health → try / (root), any 200 response = healthy, uses requests library

4. Update ApplicationProcess.start() method to: call get_health_url(self.target), wait for startup with timeout enforcement (30 seconds default), poll verify_health() every 1 second, return False and stop process if timeout expires

5. Add clean shutdown to ApplicationProcess.stop(timeout: int = 10) -> bool method: send SIGTERM for graceful shutdown, wait up to timeout seconds, force kill with SIGKILL if timeout expires, return True if clean shutdown, False if force-killed

6. Create tests/verification/test_runtime.py (or add to existing) with 6 tests: health check with running app → True, health check with stopped app → False, health check fallback (/api/health 404 → /health → True), startup timeout → RUNTIME_START_FAILURE, clean shutdown → True, force kill on timeout → False

7. Create services/project-ai/app/agents/final_gate.py with execute_final_gate(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult that: reads all gate results from run_dir/gates/*.json, reads all agent results from run_dir/agents/*.json, computes statistics from snapshot (evidence count, block counts), determines verdict (APPROVED if all gates PASS and agents SUCCESS, else REJECTED), generates FinalVerdict JSON with verdictId/timestamp/branch/commitSha/snapshotHash/verdict/gateResults/agentResults/statistics, writes verdict to .agents/tasks/final-gate-verdict-{date}.json, appends update section to .agents/tasks/m1-m2-backlog.md (never replaces), returns outputs with verdict/verdict_file/canonical_update

8. Create tests/agents/test_final_gate.py with 4 tests: all PASS → APPROVED verdict, any FAIL → REJECTED verdict, canonical backlog append preserves existing content, verdict file creation with correct JSON structure

9. Add 'final-gate' case to AgentCoordinator.execute_agent() dispatch mechanism: elif agent_id == 'final-gate': from app.agents.final_gate import execute_final_gate; return await execute_final_gate(context)
10. Run pytest tests/verification/test_runtime.py tests/agents/test_final_gate.py -v to verify all runtime and final gate tests pass
acceptance_criteria: get_health_url() function exists in runtime.py and returns correct URL for each application
ApplicationProcess.start() enforces 30-second timeout with health check polling
ApplicationProcess.stop() implements graceful shutdown with SIGTERM then SIGKILL fallback
tests/verification/test_runtime.py exists with 6 tests covering all runtime verification scenarios (all passing)
execute_final_gate() generates FinalVerdict JSON with all required fields (verdictId, timestamp, verdict, gateResults, agentResults, statistics)
execute_final_gate() appends to canonical backlog without replacing existing content
All pytest tests pass with 100% pass rate
